relevance_classifier.name: IT relevance classifier
relevance_classifier.description: Checks whether an incoming ticket is in scope before assignment-group classification.

assignment_group_classifier.name: Assignment group classifier
assignment_group_classifier.description: Automatically assigns high-confidence relevant tickets; low-confidence tickets are triaged by the LLM and sent for human review only when uncertain.

ticket_statuses.llm_review: Being classified by the LLM into an assignment group, rejection, or human review.
ticket_statuses.human_review: Waiting for a human to choose an assignment group after automated triage.
ticket_statuses.rejected: Rejected by the LLM or a client and excluded from assignment-group training data.
